# Alderwood Furniture three-way match policy

- Price tolerance: 2.0% of the purchase-order unit price per line.
- Invoiced quantity may never exceed the received quantity.
- Lines outside tolerance are entered and placed on hold with the reason; matched lines are validated for payment.
- Payment release is authorized by Le Thi Hong after the analyst's match note.

- Credit limit for Homestead Living Stores: 140000.00 USD.
- Recommend a credit hold when past-due receivables exceed 30% of the credit limit after all identified receipts are applied.
- Credit holds are approved only by Le Thi Hong; analysts recommend, they do not apply holds.
- Receipts are applied only to the invoices named on the customer's remittance advice.
